hypothesis: Does the P101 unchanged maximum-posterior-variance intervention chooser reproduce >=15% better causal effect prediction than FIT-selected strongest passive policies in independently authored anisotropic worlds with entirely new hashing/map and action generators, and does it survive a stronger classical A-optimal experimental-design control? Isotropic/correlated families provide prospective specificity and a falsification check, not permission for cherry-picking.

source.generator: Standalone P104 SHA256 four-byte keyed digest ('p104-validation-v1|seed|world|tag|i|j'); rank4 causal maps independently generated integer basis [-3,3] and V@U.T /256, no P101 world generator or P101 source seeds.

action_families.isotropic: integer [-96,96]/128 per coordinate, then unit normalize
action_families.anisotropic: coordinate integer floor-divided by 2**(j%4), then unit normalize
action_families.correlated: integer [-96,96] plus common batch latent integer times 2 across 4-coordinate blocks, then unit normalize

source.query_distribution: same family mechanism as candidate actions but independent held-out query salts and no reuse
source.information_boundary: Actions generated and visible before choice, candidate picks one index, then only consequence M@k for that action is revealed, never hidden M or any unselected outcome. Read-only queries only after training.

model.learner: Exact immutable P101 original online RLS W16x16 + P16x16 float64, 512 per task, 1024 across two tasks, prior lambda=.5, updates only after confirmed selected consequence
model.candidate: Exact P101 chooser maximum k^T P k; no new weights, new parameter tuning or CAL selection

controls.model_aware: a_opt: conventional query-covariance-weighted A-optimal one-step expected prediction risk reduction k.T@P@Sigma@P@k/(1+k.T@P@k); Sigma is a public fixed family distribution assumption, no evaluator held-out probes or latent map

source_family_covariance.correlated: I16 + 4 * c c.T, c[j]=1 if j%4==0 else 0

controls.selection: Per family and paired seed, choose lowest FIT all-query mean squared error across all three passives; additionally report strongest FIT among all four conventional arms incl a_opt; never choose controls using CAL.

model.source_info_match: All arms see same current 8 action pool, same 16 selected outcome budget and equal RLS capacity. A-opt receives only publicly frozen family covariance assumption.

acceptance.primary_anisotropic_replication: at least 2 of 3 CAL anisotropic seeds candidate all-task MSE / strongest FIT passive <=0.85, both Task0 cold and Task1 <=0.95, median all-task <=0.85
acceptance.against_robust_classical: in at least 2 of 3 anisotropic CAL seeds candidate ratio vs strongest FIT conventional including A-opt <=1.00, median <=1.00; requires primary replication also pass to assert robustness beyond traditional design
acceptance.isotropic_correlated: all three CAL seeds and medians reported, no full-universal success claim if family does not meet primary; indicate specificity

qualification.receipts: existing full G4 pytest suite emits local_runs/p104_dev_result.json into original GitHub artifact; no second science execution or new workflow

falsification: Any primary condition failing is DEV replication FAIL; report strong baseline separately. Never tune frozen cohorts after reading CAL; preserve null outcomes.
